name: @hypaware/claude-desktop
description: Claude Desktop transcript adapter for HypAware. Desktop sessions are imported from their local JSONL transcripts by the Claude provider's scheduled five-minute backfill and attributed through this plugin's entrypoint ownership.

picker.name: claude-desktop
picker.label: Claude Desktop
picker.summary: Records your Claude Desktop and Claude Code chats. Setup edits Claude Code's settings and opens a local port.
